result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, 0 failures).

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`**: `findStockLevelsByWarehouse` adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the other stock overviews use. I also updated its Javadoc, which had said zero quantities were included on purpose.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`**: new test `warehouseStockLeavesOutProductsWithNothingLeft`. It takes all nuts out of WH-1, sets screws to 0, and checks that the list shows only "Bolt 10" while `getQuantity` for nuts still returns 0.

Nothing is committed.
